It leaves the record incomplete on disclosure, not affirmative proof that certification itself was forbidden on all formulations (ISTRESS-MATERIALITY-DISPUTE-027-CONTEXT). 5. It is that certification can be defended as a launch-readiness determination, while any statement implying the disclosure predicate is already satisfied would be overbroad.
